_meta.datasheet_section: Ordering Information p2; Figure 3 TCXO pin-out (top view) + Table 13 p10; Table 2 DC; Table 8 abs max; p37 Dimensions and Land Pattern
_meta.notes: Decode: A rev, E -40..105 °C, C clipped sinewave, F 5.0x3.2, Q ±0.1 ppm, 33 = 3.3 V ±10%, N = pin 1 No Connect (TCXO mode), T = 3k reel. TCXO mode: no I2C, so pins 2/5/10 are NC. NC pins may float; layout guide recommends grounding them. IDD 44 typ / 53 max mA. [height_max_mm: SiT5356 p37 Package Size Total Thickness A max 1.060] [temp] DS Table 1 Operating Temperature Range: −40…+105 °C ambient, Extended Industrial (decoder 'E')
_meta.abs_max_notes: Table 8 (p9) also gives any input pin −0.3…Vdd+0.3 V; this variant has no input pins in our pinspec (all others NC).
